title: Shabondama Biyori / しゃぼん玉日和
tagline: 春日风景中吹泡泡，展示泡泡着色、风场模拟与自动镜头

examples.title: 泡泡镜头导演
examples.one_liner: 跟随泡泡漂流，拖动接管视线，松手后自动接回
examples.one_liner_en: Follow drifting bubbles, drag to take control of the view, and release to resume automatic following.

examples.title: 泡泡薄膜虹彩
examples.one_liner: 环绕泡泡，调节膜厚，看虹彩随视角和薄膜流动变化
examples.one_liner_en: Orbit a bubble and adjust film thickness to see colors change with the view and flowing film.

tagline_en: Blow bubbles in spring scenery, with bubble shading, wind simulation and an automatic camera.
